threads.body: [Build] These tasks inherit the repository-wide 15-minute timeout (`otel.java-conventions.gradle.kts:371-373`), so the stated 30-minute allowance for cold container pulls was removed rather than retained. Set the 30-minute timeout on each container task; the default `test` task will then continue using 15 minutes as intended.

replies.body: I removed the 30-minute override intentionally. The purpose of splitting the container tests into per-class tasks is to let each task use the standard 15-minute timeout. The PR description was stale; I've corrected it.

threads.body:
Can we have something easier to maintain than this explicit class name list ?
For example, using an explicit annotation on those classes seems easier to extend, as adding a new test class would likely be missed in the gradle config.

replies.body: Implemented in 5a6bf5b3. The container tests and KafkaContainer helper now live in `rules.containers`, and Gradle discovers the per-class tasks from that package.
